If your resume isn’t getting interviews, your skills section might be sabotaging you — and you don’t even realize it.

In this episode of Taboo Resume Advice, I break down one of the most important sections of your resume and explain what hiring managers actually look for in the first 4–5 seconds of opening it.

We talk about why skill bars, percentages, and ratings hurt your resume, the truth about “core competencies” sections, why “key achievements” sections don’t belong on resumes, and how to make your resume ATS-friendly without
